purpose: Complete the resolution interface between frozen causal-temporal carrier evidence and the native PMFS cell grid without changing M1, M2, their likelihood, or any threshold/weight/gate.

preserved_v1.reason: V1 passed all primary performance, source-label and temporal-control rules, but H01 seed3 triggered the reverse-order and tie-symmetrized catastrophe rules after uniform carrier-to-cell projection.

frozen_scientific_modules.M1: native GADEN do(S=s) physical concentration followed by the frozen run-persistent sensor operator
frozen_scientific_modules.M2: right-censored reached/not-reached evidence for each completed physical stop, with the eight-member predictive nuisance marginalized inside each stop and evidence accumulated across stops

hierarchical_projection.partition: the frozen persistent carrier partition B(x) of native free PMFS cells x
hierarchical_projection.native_carrier_mass: p_N,t(B|D_t) = sum over x in B of p_N,t(x|D_t)
hierarchical_projection.ctre_carrier_posterior: q_T,t(B|D_t), loaded byte-identically from frozen Stage 1
hierarchical_projection.interpretation: CTRE completely replaces the carrier marginal; native PMFS supplies only the within-carrier conditional p_N(x|B,D)
hierarchical_projection.I_projection: q_V2 is the unique argmin KL(q || p_N) over cell distributions whose carrier marginal equals q_T whenever q_T is absolutely continuous with respect to the native carrier support

zero_mass_policy.native_zero_and_ctre_zero: assign zero to all cells in that carrier
zero_mass_policy.native_zero_and_ctre_positive: ABSTAIN_NATIVE_CARRIER_ZERO_MASS for the entire update and return the native PMFS cell posterior exactly

frozen_arms.IDENTITY_RECONSTRUCTION: use q_T(B)=p_N(B); must reconstruct p_N(x) exactly
frozen_arms.COARSE_ONLY_V1: q_T(B) q_0(x|B), the preserved V1 uniform projection
frozen_arms.COUNT_ONLY_V2: the frozen Stage-1 count-only carrier posterior projected through p_N(x|B,D)
frozen_arms.STOP_LABEL_PERMUTE_V2: the frozen Stage-1 stop-label-permuted carrier posterior projected through p_N(x|B,D)
frozen_arms.SOURCE_LABEL_NULL_V2: the frozen Stage-1 carrier score labels are permuted before q_T is projected through the unchanged native conditional

endpoints.canonical: official ExpectedValue(sourceProbability,0.05) with ascending cell_index exact-tie order
endpoints.reverse: same endpoint with descending cell_index exact-tie order
endpoints.fixed_random: sixteen SHA256-domain-separated exact-tie orders; all are evaluated and none is selected post hoc

interpretation_boundary.joint_claim_allowed_after_pass: the joint causal-temporal carrier operator plus its resolution-consistent interface improves fixed-trajectory PMFS source localization
interpretation_boundary.separate_M2_claim: not allowed solely from this Gate because H01 showed a count-only reversal in V1
interpretation_boundary.held_out_claim: not allowed; all 30 development trajectories were already opened in V1

forbidden: changing M1, M2, threshold, stop length, sensor constants, members, carrier support or Stage-1 posteriors
adding a gate, blend coefficient, temperature, likelihood weight, House/seed rule or error-aware fallback
feeding FULL_V2 back into the independent native PMFS shadow
using V1 outcome to select among multiple projection formulas
calling a V2 development replay confirmatory or closed loop
downstream: Only a hard PASS permits one immutable runtime implementation and the requested H01/H02/H03 seeds1-3 paired 300-second closed-loop pilot. Those seeds remain development/pilot evidence; a paper claim still requires untouched held-out seeds.
